title: The Fon and his Sacred Heart class donate to the House of Hope orphanage
excerpt: On 29 July 2021 the Fon of Guneku and his silver jubilee class from Sacred Heart College, Mankon, donated grinding mills and 200,000 FCFA to the House of Hope orphanage at Ngyen-Mbo — with a basin of fish from the Palace pond.
sourceNote: Community record — Mbengwi Online (Facebook group and blog), reported by Fongoh P. Ayeh. Written fresh from the reported facts and attributed; no text or photograph of theirs is reproduced. Recorded 2026-09-02.
body:
On Thursday 29 July 2021, HRH Dr. Fomuki W. Ticha, Fon of Guneku, together with his classmates of the Sacred Heart Ex-Students’ Association (SHESA) silver jubilee class of Sacred Heart College, Mankon, donated grinding mills and 200,000 FCFA to the House of Hope orphanage at Ngyen-Mbo, Mbengwi.

The mills were fabricated by a young welder in Mbengwi and also serve the Ngyen-Mbo community, which had previously had to travel to Mile 18 to grind. The children also received a basin of fresh fish harvested from the pond in the Guneku Palace — the Guneku Integrated Fisheries Project.

The Guneku delegation

  • Ngwa Vitalis — Secretary of GUDECA, home branch
  • Ndingwan Primus — Chairman of the Guneku Traditional Council
  • Fomuki Carine — a queen of the Palace
  • Sango Della — in charge of the Guneku library
  • Fomuki Ben — a prince
  • Timo Bunde — a notable
